TeamWorkspace.title: TeamWorkspace
TeamWorkspace.description: A shared team workspace allowing colleagues to sync customers and daily electricity meter readings in real-time.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the workspace creator.

name.description: Display name of the shared team workspace.

inviteCode.description: Unique alphanumeric code shared with colleagues to join the workspace.

memberUids.description: List of authenticated Firebase UIDs belonging to this workspace (max 10).

memberNames.description: List of display names of team members in this workspace (max 10).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the workspace was created via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the workspace was last updated via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

CloudCustomer.title: CloudCustomer
CloudCustomer.description: A customer meter profile synced across team members in a shared workspace.

workspaceId.description: ID of the TeamWorkspace this customer belongs to.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the team member who created this customer record.

createdByName.description: Display name of the colleague who added this customer.

memberUids.description: Denormalized list of workspace member UIDs authorized to read and update this customer.

address.description: Site or factory address of the meter.

sanctionedLoad.description: Sanctioned connected load in kW or HP.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when created via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when updated via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

CloudReading.title: CloudReading
CloudReading.description: A daily electricity meter reading (kWh, kVArh, kVAh, PF) logged by a user or colleague and synced across the workspace.

workspaceId.description: ID of the TeamWorkspace this reading belongs to.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the colleague who logged this reading.

createdByName.description: Display name of the colleague who logged this reading.

memberUids.description: Denormalized list of workspace member UIDs authorized to view and manage this reading.

customerMeterNumber.description: Meter number linking this reading to the corresponding customer across devices.

customerName.description: Name of the customer for display in live colleague sync feeds.

readingTime.description: Formatted time of the reading (e.g., 09:30 AM).

isPfAutoCalculated.description: Whether power factor was auto-calculated from kWh/kVAh.

unitsConsumed.description: Net kWh units consumed since previous reading (0.0 if none).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when created via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when updated via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

/workspaces/{workspaceId}.description: Stores shared team workspaces for colleague synchronization.

/cloud_customers/{customerId}.description: Stores customer meter profiles shared among workspace members.

/cloud_readings/{readingId}.description: Stores daily electricity meter readings synced in real-time across colleagues.
